text:
maureen_csm: @omar_billing heads-up — FinFlux opened a support ticket: their Feb usage CSV is underreporting tokens compared to the dashboard. They hit us with an invoice discrepancy.

finflux_support_contact: We summed token_count from the CSV and got 789,143 tokens for Feb. Dashboard shows ~1,089,564. Missing ~300k tokens. CSV path: s3://redwood-usage-exports/prod/cust_finflux/2026-02-raw.csv.gz

omar_billing: Can you share invoice id and customer internal id? Also paste a few CSV lines (header + sample rows).

finflux_support_contact: Invoice INV-2026-4421, customer_id cust_finflux. Sample header row: `request_ts,customer_id,model,compact_tokens,raw_tokens` — many rows have `raw_tokens` but token_count column absent or blank.

support_inbox: Escalating to eng & data. @data_eng @syed_eng please verify if export writer changed schema or a transform skipped.

data_eng: Looking at writer release history — we rolled export-writer v2.4.1 on 2026-02-18 21:58:23 UTC. That change introduced `compact_tokens` optimization: writer allowed omitting `token_count` on compact rows expecting a downstream enrichment. If enrichment job failed for some shards, CSVs would show `raw_tokens` instead of `token_count`.

syed_eng: Repro steps I'm running against archived shards:
1) gunzip part-20260218-12.gz
2) head to inspect header
3) grep for lines with empty `token_count` or header missing `token_count`

I found shard range with header: `request_ts,customer_id,model,compact_tokens,raw_tokens` and no `token_count` column. The enrichment step that maps `raw_tokens -> token_count` didn't run for these files.

omar_billing: Dashboards read from aggregated tables that include enrichment, correct? So dashboard numbers are intact and CSV pull is missing tokens.

data_eng: Exactly. Dashboard/aggregates join raw shards to enrichment output. The CSV export job writes raw shard rows directly. During a migration window, some in-flight shards skipped the enrichment join. Affected window: 2026-02-18T20:30:00Z -> 2026-02-19T02:15:00Z.

maureen_csm: Customer is asking for either corrected CSVs or an invoice adjustment. They need an ETA and a diff breakdown by day.

syed_eng: Remediation plan (short-term):
- Identify all affected shards for cust_finflux in that window
- Run a one-off enrichment transform that adds `token_count = COALESCE(token_count, raw_tokens)`
- Produce corrected CSVs and upload to s3://redwood-usage-exports/prod/cust_finflux/2026-02-raw-corrected-<run_ts>.csv.gz

export-bot: deployment-log: export-writer v2.4.1 rolled at 2026-02-18T21:58:23Z, flag `compact_tokens` enabled.

omar_billing: Approved. Also propose a customer-facing credit for the delta while we confirm. Maureen, please coordinate comms.

data_eng: Running enrichment now. SQL transform applied:
```
SELECT request_ts, customer_id, model,
       COALESCE(token_count, raw_tokens, 0) AS token_count,
       compact_tokens
FROM raw_shard_20260218_part12
```
Job id: enrich-90823 started at 1765127005 (unix ts). Estimated 9m.

support_inbox: Make sure to record original shard names, checksums, and corrected upload path in the ticket. Also flag for a backfill audit to find other customers affected by the same window.

syed_eng: Enrichment finished. Uploading corrected file to s3://redwood-usage-exports/prod/cust_finflux/2026-02-raw-corrected-1765127129.csv.gz
Checksum (sha256): 6f2a9b3c... (full checksum in ticket).

maureen_csm: Sent corrected CSV and a summary diff to FinFlux. Quick summary of regenerated tokens by day:
- 2026-02-16: 0
- 2026-02-17: 3,214
- 2026-02-18: 197,831
- 2026-02-19: 99,376
Customer acknowledged receipt and asked us to confirm invoice adjustment if they re-import. I offered a one-time credit for the delta pending confirmation.

omar_billing: Action items to prevent recurrence:
1) Add a pre-upload validation to the export pipeline: assert `token_count` present for rows OR fail the upload.
2) Run a company-wide scan of exported CSVs between 2026-02-18T20:00 and 2026-02-19T03:00 to find any other customers with missing token_count.
3) Fix migration orchestration so enrichment toggles are atomic for in-flight shards.

data_eng: Opened GH issue #5487 with migration logs, affected shard list, and a unit test for writer schema. Scheduling a periodic job that scans uploads for `compact_tokens=true` with missing `token_count`.

finflux_support_contact: Thanks for the swift handling. We'll reconcile after re-import; appreciate the temporary credit offer.
